families.name: tensorfold:requests_total
families.help: HTTP replies by API key label and status.
families.condition: only once an HTTP reply has been counted

families.name: tensorfold:requests_running
families.help: Requests in prefill or decode.

families.name: tensorfold:requests_waiting
families.help: Requests queued or held until a lane is free.

families.name: tensorfold:generation_tokens_running
families.help: Generated tokens held by live streams.

families.name: tensorfold:prompt_tokens_total
families.help: Prompt tokens of finished requests, those restored from kept prompt states included.

families.name: tensorfold:prompt_tokens_cached_total
families.help: Prompt tokens of finished requests restored from kept prompt states (counted in prompt_tokens_total too); the rest were computed.

families.name: tensorfold:generation_tokens_total
families.help: Generated tokens of finished requests.

families.name: tensorfold:joules_total
families.help: Energy this rank's GPU used over finished requests' own windows, in joules (TF_DS_ENERGY; rank 1 logs its own, per frame).

families.name: tensorfold:kv_cache_usage_ratio
families.help: Tokens in a stream cache divided by that stream's context window.

families.name: tensorfold:mtp_drafted_total
families.help: Draft tokens verified on finished requests.

families.name: tensorfold:mtp_accepted_total
families.help: Draft tokens kept on finished requests.

families.name: tensorfold:decode_rounds_total
families.help: Decode rounds used by finished requests.

families.name: tensorfold:process_footprint_bytes
families.help: This process's physical footprint as the OS counts it, Metal buffers included; only where the platform reports one (macOS).

families.name: tensorfold:device_memory_bytes
families.help: Device memory the engine holds now: weights, caches and live streams; only where the backend counts it (CUDA).

families.name: tensorfold:device_memory_peak_bytes
families.help: The most device memory the engine has held since start or the last /health?reset_peak=1.

families.name: tensorfold:num_requests_running
families.help: Requests in prefill or decode. A mirror of tensorfold:requests_running.

families.name: tensorfold:num_requests_waiting
families.help: Requests queued or held until a lane is free. A mirror of tensorfold:requests_waiting.

families.name: tensorfold:kv_cache_usage_perc
families.help: A stream's cache occupancy under vLLM's name; same streams and ratios as tensorfold:kv_cache_usage_ratio.

families.name: tensorfold:spec_decode_num_draft_tokens_total
families.help: Draft tokens verified on finished requests, this server's single draft counter.

families.name: tensorfold:spec_decode_num_accepted_tokens_total
families.help: Draft tokens kept on finished requests.

families.name: tensorfold:prefix_cache_queries_total
families.help: Prompt tokens of finished requests, looked up in the kept prompt states, under vLLM's name.

families.name: tensorfold:prefix_cache_hits_total
families.help: Prompt tokens of finished requests restored from kept prompt states, under vLLM's name.

families.name: tensorfold:client_disconnections_total
families.help: Requests a client left before the reply left the server.

families.name: tensorfold:preemptions_total
families.help: Requests that had to give a lane up to a later one.

families.name: tensorfold:engram_rowcache_has_total
families.help: Row-cache has() calls.

families.name: tensorfold:engram_rowcache_fast_total
families.help: Row-cache has() calls the filter answered without the lock (TF_DS_ENGRAM_ROWCACHE_FILTER).

families.name: tensorfold:engram_rowcache_lock_total
families.help: Row-cache has() calls that took the lock (the filter's positives, true or false).

families.name: tensorfold:request_latency_seconds
families.help: Seconds from arrival to the reply leaving.

families.name: tensorfold:time_to_first_token_seconds
families.help: Seconds from arrival to the first generated token.

families.name: tensorfold:request_decode_seconds
families.help: Seconds a finished request spent decoding. Its sum over generation_tokens_total is the decode rate.

families.name: tensorfold:request_time_per_output_token_seconds
families.help: Seconds from the first generated token to the last, divided by the tokens less one.

families.name: tensorfold:request_prefill_seconds
families.help: Seconds a finished request's prompt pass took.

families.name: tensorfold:e2e_request_latency_seconds
families.help: Seconds from arrival to the reply leaving, under vLLM's name.

families.name: tensorfold:request_decode_time_seconds
families.help: Seconds a finished request spent decoding, under vLLM's name.

families.name: tensorfold:request_prefill_time_seconds
families.help: Seconds a finished request's prompt pass took, under vLLM's name.

families.name: tensorfold:engram_lookup_seconds
families.help: Seconds a read of Engram's table rows took, one observation per read (a decode round's, a prompt chunk's or a read-ahead's).

families.name: tensorfold:chats_continued
families.help: Streams that continued a conversation without resuming from its own turn state.

families.name: tensorfold:chats_continued_prefill_tokens
families.help: Prompt tokens those streams prefilled.

families.name: tensorfold:prompt_cache_memory_hits
families.help: Prompt passes that resumed a kept state in memory.

families.name: tensorfold:prompt_cache_memory_misses
families.help: Prompt lookups that found no usable kept state.

families.name: tensorfold:prompt_cache_kept
families.help: Prompt states kept in memory.

families.name: tensorfold:prompt_cache_evicted
families.help: Kept states evicted from memory for room.

families.name: tensorfold:prompt_cache_refused
families.help: Prompt states not kept: past the memory budget.

families.name: tensorfold:prompt_cache_failed
families.help: Kept states that failed to save or restore.

families.name: tensorfold:prompt_cache_entries
families.help: Prompt states kept in memory now.

families.name: tensorfold:prompt_cache_held_bytes
families.help: Bytes the kept states hold now.

families.name: tensorfold:prompt_cache_disk_lookups
families.help: Lookups that asked the disk tier.

families.name: tensorfold:prompt_cache_disk_hits
families.help: Lookups whose durable point was longer than the best usable memory state.

families.name: tensorfold:prompt_cache_disk_hits_committed
families.help: Disk restores every rank installed, adopted as kept states.

families.name: tensorfold:prompt_cache_restores_begun
families.help: Disk restore jobs started.

families.name: tensorfold:prompt_cache_restores_shared
families.help: Requests that joined a disk restore already in flight.

families.name: tensorfold:prompt_cache_restores_failed
families.help: Disk restores aborted on every rank (missing, damaged, guarded).

families.name: tensorfold:prompt_cache_restores_cancelled
families.help: Disk restores stopped: no request waited for them any more, or shutdown.

families.name: tensorfold:prompt_cache_restores_dropped
families.help: Installed disk restores not adopted: no room, or memory already had them.

families.name: tensorfold:prompt_cache_restores_refused
families.help: Disk restores not begun: the memory budget could not hold their destination, or the tier was at its capacity (once a request).

families.name: tensorfold:prompt_cache_restores_active
families.help: Disk restore jobs in flight.

families.name: tensorfold:prompt_cache_restoring_bytes
families.help: Memory the disk restores in flight reserved, charged to the prompt cache's budget.

families.name: tensorfold:prompt_cache_restore_blocks_done
families.help: Blocks the restores in flight have copied so far.

families.name: tensorfold:prompt_cache_restore_blocks_total
families.help: Blocks the restores in flight copy in all.

families.name: tensorfold:prompt_cache_restored_tokens
families.help: Prompt tokens restored from disk.

families.name: tensorfold:prompt_cache_restore_waits
families.help: Requests parked on a disk restore.

families.name: tensorfold:prompt_cache_restore_wait_timeouts
families.help: Requests admitted without their disk restore after TF_SPILL_LOAD_WAIT_MS.

families.name: tensorfold:prompt_cache_restore_wait_ns
families.help: Nanoseconds requests waited for disk restores.

families.name: tensorfold:prompt_cache_restore_wait_max_ns
families.help: The longest wait for a disk restore, in nanoseconds.

families.name: tensorfold:prompt_cache_restores_deferred
families.help: Requests whose disk restore was refused for capacity (restores or read slots in flight) and retried shortly instead of prefilling.

families.name: tensorfold:prompt_cache_restores_deferred_expired
families.help: Of them, requests admitted on what memory holds after TF_SPILL_DEFER_MS without the restore starting.

families.name: tensorfold:prompt_cache_restores_room_waits
families.help: Requests whose disk restore the KV pool had no room for while streams ran, and that waited for room as a prompt pass does instead of prefilling.

families.name: tensorfold:prompt_cache_restores_room_wait_expired
families.help: Of them, requests admitted on what memory holds after TF_SPILL_LOAD_WAIT_MS without room for the restore.

families.name: tensorfold:prompt_cache_writes_enqueued
families.help: Kept states enqueued for the disk tier at their keep.

families.name: tensorfold:prompt_cache_shared_promoted
families.help: Disk points promoted to shared prefixes.

families.name: tensorfold:prompt_cache_flushes
families.help: Clean-shutdown flushes of the disk tier.

families.name: tensorfold:prompt_cache_flush_timeouts
families.help: Flushes that reached their deadline with points unpublished.

families.name: tensorfold:prompt_cache_flush_unpublished
families.help: Points left unpublished at a flush deadline.

families.name: tensorfold:prompt_cache_parked
families.help: Requests parked on a disk restore now (reading it, or deferred to ask again).

families.name: tensorfold:prompt_cache_chats_continued
families.help: Streams that continued a conversation without resuming from its own turn state.

families.name: tensorfold:prompt_cache_chats_continued_prefill_tokens
families.help: Prompt tokens those streams prefilled.

families.name: tensorfold:prompt_cache_cached_tokens
families.help: Prompt tokens passes resumed from kept states.

families.name: tensorfold:prompt_cache_computed_tokens
families.help: Prompt tokens passes computed.

families.name: tensorfold:prompt_cache_misses_no_prefix
families.help: Of memory_misses: no kept state's tokens matched the prompt's.

families.name: tensorfold:prompt_cache_misses_tail_window
families.help: Of memory_misses: a state matched but the tail, window or grid rules passed it over.

families.name: tensorfold:prompt_cache_misses_stale
families.help: Of memory_misses: a state matched but the family staled it.

families.name: tensorfold:prompt_cache_refused_budget
families.help: Of refused: the state alone passed the memory budget.

families.name: tensorfold:prompt_cache_refused_restores
families.help: Of refused: restores in flight held the budget's rest.

families.name: tensorfold:prompt_cache_evicted_superseded
families.help: Of evicted: a state a later prompt extends (its superseded turn).

families.name: tensorfold:prompt_cache_evicted_lru
families.help: Of evicted: the least recently used state.

families.name: tensorfold:prompt_cache_failed_save
families.help: Of failed: a keep's save failed.

families.name: tensorfold:prompt_cache_failed_restore
families.help: Of failed: a restore failed (this pass's resume, or a peer's).

families.name: tensorfold:prompt_cache_resume_depth_percent
families.help: The resume depth of finished prompt passes (0/25/50/75/90/99/100 percent buckets).

families.name: tensorfold:spill_points
families.help: Published points in this rank's disk tier.

families.name: tensorfold:spill_blocks
families.help: Unique blocks on this rank's disk.

families.name: tensorfold:spill_stored_bytes
families.help: Unique bytes the disk tier holds (blocks, point files, temporaries).

families.name: tensorfold:spill_cap_bytes
families.help: The disk tier's cap (--spill-gib).

families.name: tensorfold:spill_disk_free_bytes
families.help: Free bytes on the disk tier's file system.

families.name: tensorfold:spill_staging_bytes
families.help: Host staging the disk tier holds now.

families.name: tensorfold:spill_staging_peak
families.help: The most host staging the disk tier has held.

families.name: tensorfold:spill_writes_pending
families.help: Kept states queued for the disk, not yet published.

families.name: tensorfold:spill_writes_queued
families.help: Kept states queued for the disk.

families.name: tensorfold:spill_writes_committed
families.help: Points published on disk (manifest last).

families.name: tensorfold:spill_writes_cancelled
families.help: Unpublished points cancelled (a guard could not stage, staging full, shutdown).

families.name: tensorfold:spill_writes_cancelled_guard
families.help: Unpublished points cancelled because their source was about to change.

families.name: tensorfold:spill_writes_cancelled_staging
families.help: Unpublished points cancelled because staging had no room.

families.name: tensorfold:spill_writes_cancelled_shutdown
families.help: Unpublished points cancelled at the flush deadline.

families.name: tensorfold:spill_writes_failed
families.help: Disk writes that failed.

families.name: tensorfold:spill_forced_staging
families.help: Ranges staged at once because their source was about to change.

families.name: tensorfold:spill_no_space
families.help: Writes refused by the cap or the free-disk floor.

families.name: tensorfold:spill_dedup_blocks
families.help: Blocks linked to equal bytes already on disk.

families.name: tensorfold:spill_dedup_bytes
families.help: Bytes those links saved.

families.name: tensorfold:spill_written_bytes
families.help: Bytes written to disk.

families.name: tensorfold:spill_presence_refused
families.help: Restores refused because a rank lacked the point.

families.name: tensorfold:spill_compatible_misses
families.help: Durable lookups with no compatible point.

families.name: tensorfold:spill_crc_errors
families.help: Blocks or sections that failed their CRC.

families.name: tensorfold:spill_size_errors
families.help: Files truncated or past their manifest's bounds.

families.name: tensorfold:spill_reads
families.help: Points read for restores.

families.name: tensorfold:spill_read_bytes
families.help: Bytes read for restores.

families.name: tensorfold:spill_read_failed
families.help: Restore reads that failed.

families.name: tensorfold:spill_evicted_turns
families.help: Old turns evicted from disk.

families.name: tensorfold:spill_evicted_forks
families.help: Abandoned forks evicted from disk.

families.name: tensorfold:spill_evicted_conversations
families.help: Whole conversations evicted from disk.

families.name: tensorfold:spill_evicted_shared
families.help: Shared-prefix points evicted from disk.

families.name: tensorfold:spill_quota_trims
families.help: Writes that trimmed their conversation to its quota.

families.name: tensorfold:spill_recovered_points
families.help: Published points found at start.

families.name: tensorfold:spill_dropped_temporaries
families.help: Incomplete records removed at start.

families.help: Points written to disk with pictures before their cut.

families.name: tensorfold:spill_pictures_refused
families.help: Disk keeps and lookups with pictures turned away (ids and media disagree, or image cache off).
